// Synthetic coherent owner projection; this is a pure policy fixture, not an
// actual Student consent, evidence-commit or persistence proof.
func hybridEvaluatorFixture(t *testing.T) (HybridPlanningSnapshot, HybridConsequenceInputs) {
	t.Helper()
	id := func(v string) string { return uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("hybrid-evaluator:"+v)).String() }
	target := HybridTargetRef{Type: TargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}
	signal := HybridSnapshotSignal{Status: "DERIVED_BY_PLANNER", ReasonCode: "PLANNER_POLICY_HYBRID_V1"}
	s := HybridPlanningSnapshot{Schema: HybridSnapshotSchema, StudentID: id("student"), LearningPathID: id("path"), CapturedAt: time.Date(2026, 10, 5, 1, 2, 3, 0, time.UTC), TriggerContext: HybridSnapshotTrigger{Kind: "objective_evidence", Reason: "synthetic coherent policy fixture"}, RequestedTargets: []HybridTargetRef{target}, Profile: HybridSnapshotProfile{ProfileVersion: StudentPlanningProfileVersion, OwnerVersion: 1, DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "beginner", KnownStacks: []string{}, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "learn_programming", PreferredLanguage: "ru", WeeklyMinutes: 120, PreferredPace: "normal"}, Path: HybridSnapshotPath{ID: id("path"), CourseID: id("course"), GoalCode: "go.backend", CourseFingerprint: "fixture", PolicyVersion: "student-learning-path-v1", PlannerPolicyVersion: PlannerVersion, Status: "ACTIVE", Version: 1, JourneyVersion: 1, Items: []HybridSnapshotItem{{ID: id("ready"), ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: id("lesson-ready"), Position: 0, Status: LearningPathItemReady, Targets: []HybridTargetRef{target}, FrozenRequirements: []HybridLessonRequirement{}}, {ID: id("future"), ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: id("lesson-future"), Position: 1, Status: LearningPathItemPlanned, Targets: []HybridTargetRef{target}, FrozenRequirements: []HybridLessonRequirement{}}}}, Mastery: []HybridSnapshotMastery{{Target: target, State: MasteryMastered, MasteryScore: 1, Confidence: .8, IndependentSuccessCount: 8, EvidenceCount: 8, PolicyVersion: StudentMasteryPolicyVersion}}, Evidence: []HybridEvidenceReference{}, ActivityFacts: []HybridSnapshotActivityFact{}, CourseBindings: []HybridCourseActionBinding{}, PracticeBindings: []HybridPracticeBinding{}, Availability: HybridSnapshotAvailability{EvidenceQuality: signal, Stability: signal, RuntimeHold: HybridSnapshotSignal{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", ReasonCode: "RUNTIME_HOLD_NOT_OBSERVED"}, AutomaticAdaptation: HybridSnapshotSignal{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", ReasonCode: "AUTOMATIC_ADAPTATION_NOT_DEFINED"}, StudentPinning: HybridSnapshotSignal{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", ReasonCode: "STUDENT_PINNING_NOT_DEFINED"}}}
	for n := 0; n < 8; n++ {
		eid := id(string(rune('a' + n)))
		s.Evidence = append(s.Evidence, HybridEvidenceReference{SourceKind: "course_answer", EvidenceID: eid, LearningActionID: eid, TaskID: id(string(rune('x' + n%2))), Target: target, EvidenceClass: "application", Outcome: "passed", SupportContext: "independent", Kind: "independent_application", TeacherPolicyVersion: "teacher-support-v1", MasteryPolicyVersion: StudentMasteryPolicyVersion, OccurredAt: s.CapturedAt})
	}
	s.References, _ = HybridSnapshotReferencesFor(s)
	policy := PolicyBundle{PlannerVersion: PlannerVersion, PedagogyProfile: DefaultPedagogyProfile, PresentationStyle: DefaultPresentationStyle, GenerationPolicy: DefaultGenerationPolicy, MasterySkipConfidence: .8, PedagogyStrategies: []PedagogyStrategyVersion{{Code: "explicit_instruction", Version: 1, Config: json.RawMessage(`{}`)}}}
	inputs, err := NormalizeHybridConsequenceInputs(policy, HybridPrerequisiteGraph{Targets: []HybridPrerequisiteTarget{}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return s, inputs
}

func TestHybridEvaluatorPositiveRequiresCompleteStableFutureEvidence(t *testing.T) {
	s, inputs := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
	c, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
	if err != nil || c.Outcome != HybridOutcomeReplanNeeded || c.ApplicationMode != HybridApplicationAuto || len(c.Mutations) != 1 || c.Mutations[0].ItemID != s.Path.Items[1].ID || c.Mutations[0].Kind != "SKIP_REDUNDANT_PENDING_ITEM" {
		t.Fatalf("complete stable future evidence did not propose precise AUTO skip: %+v err=%v", c, err)
	}
}

func rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t *testing.T, s *HybridPlanningSnapshot) {
	t.Helper()
	sort.Slice(s.Mastery, func(i, j int) bool {
		return hybridTargetIdentity(s.Mastery[i].Target) < hybridTargetIdentity(s.Mastery[j].Target)
	})
	var err error
	s.References, err = HybridSnapshotReferencesFor(*s)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func hasHybridReason(c HybridConsequence, reason string) bool {
	for _, r := range c.ReasonCodes {
		if r == reason {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func TestHybridEvaluatorRequiredNoChangeMatrix(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		modify func(*HybridPlanningSnapshot)
		reason string
	}{
		{"one quiz pass", func(s *HybridPlanningSnapshot) {
			s.Evidence = s.Evidence[:1]
			s.Evidence[0].EvidenceClass = "knowledge_check"
			s.Evidence[0].Kind = "independent_understanding"
			s.Mastery[0].State = MasteryUnderstood
			s.Mastery[0].EvidenceCount = 1
			s.Mastery[0].IndependentSuccessCount = 1
			s.Mastery[0].Confidence = .33333
		}, "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_QUALITY"},
		{"assessment only", func(s *HybridPlanningSnapshot) {
			for i := range s.Evidence {
				s.Evidence[i].EvidenceClass = "knowledge_check"
				s.Evidence[i].Kind = "independent_understanding"
			}
		}, "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_QUALITY"},
		{"one failed submission", func(s *HybridPlanningSnapshot) {
			s.Evidence = s.Evidence[:1]
			s.Evidence[0].Outcome = "failed"
			s.Evidence[0].Kind = "failed_application"
			s.Mastery[0].State = MasteryUnknown
			s.Mastery[0].EvidenceCount = 1
			s.Mastery[0].IndependentSuccessCount = 0
			s.Mastery[0].FailureCount = 1
			s.Mastery[0].Confidence = .33333
		}, "UNSTABLE_MASTERY"},
		{"unstable application", func(s *HybridPlanningSnapshot) {
			s.Evidence = s.Evidence[:1]
			s.Mastery[0].EvidenceCount = 1
			s.Mastery[0].IndependentSuccessCount = 1
		}, "UNSTABLE_MASTERY"},
		{"developing application", func(s *HybridPlanningSnapshot) {
			s.Evidence = s.Evidence[:2]
			s.Mastery[0].EvidenceCount = 2
			s.Mastery[0].IndependentSuccessCount = 2
		}, "UNSTABLE_MASTERY"},
		{"stable below exact threshold", func(s *HybridPlanningSnapshot) { s.Mastery[0].Confidence = .79999 }, "CONFIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT"},
		{"mastered no redundant future", func(s *HybridPlanningSnapshot) { s.Path.Items[1].Status = LearningPathItemCompleted }, "NO_RELEVANT_FUTURE_ITEMS"},
		{"empty future targets", func(s *HybridPlanningSnapshot) { s.Path.Items[1].Targets = []HybridTargetRef{} }, "NO_RELEVANT_FUTURE_ITEMS"},
		{"history already skipped confidence wobble", func(s *HybridPlanningSnapshot) {
			s.Path.Items[1].Status = LearningPathItemSkippedMastered
			s.Mastery[0].Confidence = .79
		}, "NO_RELEVANT_FUTURE_ITEMS"},
		{"unknown quality", func(s *HybridPlanningSnapshot) {
			for i := range s.Evidence {
				e := &s.Evidence[i]
				e.SourceKind = "practice_v2"
				e.TaskInstanceID = e.TaskID
				e.TaskID = ""
				e.TaskRevisionID = uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("revision")).String()
				e.SubmissionID = e.EvidenceID
				e.ReceiptHash = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64)
			}
		}, "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_QUALITY"},
		{"closed path", func(s *HybridPlanningSnapshot) { s.Path.Status = "COMPLETED" }, "NO_RELEVANT_FUTURE_ITEMS"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			s, inputs := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
			tc.modify(&s)
			rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
			c, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
			if err != nil || c.Outcome != HybridOutcomeNoChange || c.ApplicationMode != "" || len(c.Mutations) != 0 || !hasHybridReason(c, tc.reason) {
				t.Fatalf("c=%+v err=%v", c, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestHybridEvaluatorAllTargetsAndProtectedOccurrences(t *testing.T) {
	s, inputs := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
	extra := HybridTargetRef{Type: TargetCapability, Key: "go.debug", Version: "v1"}
	s.RequestedTargets = append(s.RequestedTargets, extra)
	sortHybridTargets(s.RequestedTargets)
	s.Path.Items[1].Targets = append(s.Path.Items[1].Targets, extra)
	s.Mastery = append(s.Mastery, HybridSnapshotMastery{Target: extra, State: MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: StudentMasteryPolicyVersion})
	sortHybridCollections(&s)
	rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
	c, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
	if err != nil || c.Outcome != HybridOutcomeNoChange {
		t.Fatalf("unmastered second target skipped c=%+v err=%v", c, err)
	}
	for _, status := range []LearningPathItemStatus{LearningPathItemReady, LearningPathItemInProgress, LearningPathItemCompleted, LearningPathItemSkippedMastered} {
		t.Run(string(status), func(t *testing.T) {
			s, inputs := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
			s.Path.Items[0].Status = LearningPathItemCompleted
			s.Path.Items[1].Status = status
			rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
			c, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
			if err != nil || len(c.Mutations) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("protected occurrence changed c=%+v err=%v", c, err)
			}
		})
	}
	for _, lifecycle := range []string{"RESERVED", "OPEN"} {
		t.Run("binding "+lifecycle, func(t *testing.T) {
			s, inputs := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
			revision := uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("binding-revision")).String()
			s.Path.Items[1].ReferenceType = "practice"
			s.Path.Items[1].ReferenceID = revision
			s.PracticeBindings = []HybridPracticeBinding{{LearningActionID: uuid.New().String(), TaskInstanceID: uuid.New().String(), TaskRevisionID: revision, TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64), LearningPathID: s.LearningPathID, SurfaceClassification: "practice", LifecycleStatus: lifecycle, LearningTargets: s.Path.Items[1].Targets, LearningPathVersionReservation: 1, LearningPathPositionReservation: 1}}
			rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
			c, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
			if err != nil || len(c.Mutations) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("active binding changed c=%+v err=%v", c, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestHybridEvaluatorDeterminismOwnershipAndPinnedThreshold(t *testing.T) {
	s, inputs := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
	before, _ := json.Marshal(s)
	c, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s.CapturedAt = s.CapturedAt.Add(time.Hour)
	s.TriggerContext.Reason = "different trace"
	reordered := append([]HybridEvidenceReference{}, s.Evidence...)
	for i, j := 0, len(reordered)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
		reordered[i], reordered[j] = reordered[j], reordered[i]
	}
	s.Evidence = reordered
	again, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(c, again) {
		t.Fatalf("trace/order changed result %+v %+v err=%v", c, again, err)
	}
	c.DesiredScope.DesiredStacks[0] = "mutated-output"
	if s.Profile.DesiredStacks[0] != "go" {
		t.Fatal("result aliases owner input")
	}
	s, inputs = hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
	after, _ := json.Marshal(s)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(before, after) {
		t.Fatal("fixture changed")
	}
	inputs.Policy.MasterySkipConfidence = .9
	inputs, err = NormalizeHybridConsequenceInputs(inputs.Policy, inputs.Graph)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	c, err = EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
	if err != nil || c.Outcome != HybridOutcomeNoChange || !hasHybridReason(c, "CONFIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT") {
		t.Fatalf("existing policy threshold ignored %+v err=%v", c, err)
	}
	inputs.InputHash = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("e", 64)
	if _, err = EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("forged policy pin accepted")
	}
}

func TestHybridEvaluatorExistingGapOnlyReordersFrozenFutureSlots(t *testing.T) {
	s, inputs := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
	a := s.RequestedTargets[0]
	b := HybridTargetRef{Type: TargetConcept, Key: "go.functions", Version: "v1"}
	s.Path.Items[1].Targets = []HybridTargetRef{b}
	third := s.Path.Items[1]
	third.ID = uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("prerequisite-item")).String()
	third.Position = 2
	third.Targets = []HybridTargetRef{a}
	s.Path.Items = append(s.Path.Items, third)
	s.RequestedTargets = sortHybridTargetRefs([]HybridTargetRef{a, b})
	s.Evidence = []HybridEvidenceReference{}
	s.Mastery = []HybridSnapshotMastery{{Target: a, State: MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: StudentMasteryPolicyVersion}, {Target: b, State: MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: StudentMasteryPolicyVersion}}
	sortHybridCollections(&s)
	rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
	graph := HybridPrerequisiteGraph{Available: true, GoalCode: s.Path.GoalCode, GoalVersion: "v1", GraphVersion: "v1", Targets: []HybridPrerequisiteTarget{{Ref: a, Prerequisites: []HybridTargetRef{}}, {Ref: b, Prerequisites: []HybridTargetRef{a}}}}
	inputs, err := NormalizeHybridConsequenceInputs(inputs.Policy, graph)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	before, _ := json.Marshal(s)
	c, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
	if err != nil || c.Outcome != HybridOutcomeReplanNeeded || len(c.Mutations) != 2 || !hasHybridReason(c, "EXISTING_PREREQUISITE_GAP") {
		t.Fatalf("accepted graph gap %+v err=%v", c, err)
	}
	for _, m := range c.Mutations {
		if m.Kind != "REORDER_PENDING_ITEMS" || *m.TargetPosition == 0 {
			t.Fatal("gap invented material or changed active slot")
		}
	}
	after, _ := json.Marshal(s)
	if string(before) != string(after) {
		t.Fatal("gap mutated source")
	}
	// Complete mastery coverage is mandatory; the evaluator cannot combine another read.
	s.RequestedTargets = []HybridTargetRef{b}
	s.Mastery = []HybridSnapshotMastery{{Target: b, State: MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: StudentMasteryPolicyVersion}}
	rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
	if _, err = EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("partial snapshot accepted")
	}
	// The available graph alone cannot create missing prerequisite material.
	s, base := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
	s.Path.Items[1].Targets = []HybridTargetRef{b}
	s.RequestedTargets = sortHybridTargetRefs([]HybridTargetRef{a, b})
	s.Evidence = []HybridEvidenceReference{}
	s.Mastery = []HybridSnapshotMastery{{Target: a, State: MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: StudentMasteryPolicyVersion}, {Target: b, State: MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: StudentMasteryPolicyVersion}}
	sortHybridCollections(&s)
	rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
	inputs, _ = NormalizeHybridConsequenceInputs(base.Policy, graph)
	c, err = EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
	if err != nil || c.Outcome != HybridOutcomeNoChange || len(c.Mutations) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("missing material invented %+v err=%v", c, err)
	}
}

func TestHybridSyntheticIntentProjectionRequiresBoundProvenance(t *testing.T) {
	s, inputs := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
	old := s.References
	s.PendingIntent = &HybridLearningIntentProjection{IntentID: uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("synthetic-intent-not-consent")).String(), StudentID: s.StudentID, LearningPathID: s.LearningPathID, ExpectedPathRevision: s.Path.Version, Kind: "CHANGE_GOAL", CreatedAt: s.CapturedAt, RequestedChange: HybridRequestedChange{Scope: HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: "go.advanced", DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}}, Mutations: []HybridFutureMutation{}}}
	rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
	if s.References.LearnerRef == old.LearnerRef || s.References.SnapshotRef == old.SnapshotRef || s.References.MasteryRef != old.MasteryRef {
		t.Fatal("bound intent absent from learner hash or contaminated mastery")
	}
	c, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
	if err != nil || c.ApplicationMode != HybridApplicationRequiresIntent || c.IntentID != s.PendingIntent.IntentID || c.RequiredIntentKind != "CHANGE_GOAL" || len(c.Mutations) != 0 || !hasHybridReason(c, "EXPLICIT_LEARNER_INTENT") {
		t.Fatalf("synthetic major proposal %+v err=%v", c, err)
	}
	s.PendingIntent.ExpectedPathRevision++
	rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
	if _, err = EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("stale intent accepted")
	}
	s.PendingIntent.ExpectedPathRevision--
	s.PendingIntent.StudentID = uuid.New().String()
	rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
	if _, err = EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("foreign intent accepted")
	}
	s, inputs = hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
	c, err = EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
	if err != nil || c.ApplicationMode != HybridApplicationAuto || c.BaselineScope.GoalCode != s.Path.GoalCode {
		t.Fatal("onboarding profile/path goal mapping inferred consent")
	}
}

func TestHybridConsequenceValidationAndCanonicalInputOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	s, inputs := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
	policy := inputs.Policy
	policy.PedagogyStrategies = append(policy.PedagogyStrategies, PedagogyStrategyVersion{Code: "guided_practice", Version: 1, Priority: 10, Config: json.RawMessage(`{"z":1,"a":2}`)})
	before, _ := json.Marshal(policy)
	pin, err := NormalizeHybridConsequenceInputs(policy, inputs.Graph)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	after, _ := json.Marshal(policy)
	if string(before) != string(after) {
		t.Fatal("policy normalization mutated caller slice")
	}
	pin2, err := NormalizeHybridConsequenceInputs(pin.Policy, pin.Graph)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(pin, pin2) {
		t.Fatal("pins not canonical/idempotent")
	}
	c, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	hash, err := HybridConsequencePayloadHash(c)
	if err != nil || !hybridDigest(hash) {
		t.Fatal("result lacks canonical digest")
	}
	for _, mutate := range []func(*HybridConsequence){func(c *HybridConsequence) { c.ConsequenceID = uuid.New().String() }, func(c *HybridConsequence) { c.PolicyVersion = "new-heuristic" }, func(c *HybridConsequence) { c.ApplicationMode = HybridApplicationRequiresIntent }, func(c *HybridConsequence) { c.DesiredScope.GoalCode = "other" }, func(c *HybridConsequence) { c.ReasonCodes = []string{"invented"} }, func(c *HybridConsequence) { c.Mutations[0].Kind = "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY" }, func(c *HybridConsequence) { c.Outcome = HybridOutcomeNoChange }} {
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(c)
		var malformed HybridConsequence
		json.Unmarshal(raw, &malformed)
		mutate(&malformed)
		if ValidateHybridConsequence(malformed) == nil {
			t.Fatalf("malformed result accepted %+v", malformed)
		}
	}
	a := s.RequestedTargets[0]
	graph := HybridPrerequisiteGraph{Available: true, GoalCode: s.Path.GoalCode, GoalVersion: "v1", GraphVersion: "v1", Targets: []HybridPrerequisiteTarget{{Ref: a, Prerequisites: []HybridTargetRef{a}}}}
	if _, err := NormalizeHybridConsequenceInputs(inputs.Policy, graph); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("cyclic graph pin accepted")
	}
}

func TestHybridAbsentIntentPreservesFrozenLearnerHash(t *testing.T) {
	s, _ := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
	old, err := hybridSnapshotDigest(struct {
		Schema, StudentID string
		Profile           HybridSnapshotProfile
		Path              HybridSnapshotPath
		ActivityFacts     []HybridSnapshotActivityFact
		CourseBindings    []HybridCourseActionBinding
		PracticeBindings  []HybridPracticeBinding
		Availability      HybridSnapshotAvailability
	}{"student-learner-planning-ref.v1", s.StudentID, s.Profile, s.Path, s.ActivityFacts, s.CourseBindings, s.PracticeBindings, s.Availability})
	if err != nil || old != s.References.LearnerRef {
		t.Fatalf("absent optional intent broke accepted legacy reference old=%s current=%s err=%v", old, s.References.LearnerRef, err)
	}
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(s)
	if strings.Contains(string(raw), "pending_intent") {
		t.Fatal("absent projection not omitted")
	}
}

func TestHybridEvaluatorObservationOnlyCannotSkipFuture(t *testing.T) {
	s, inputs := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
	s.Evidence = []HybridEvidenceReference{}
	s.Mastery[0] = HybridSnapshotMastery{Target: s.RequestedTargets[0], State: MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: StudentMasteryPolicyVersion}
	item := &s.Path.Items[0]
	item.LessonRevisionID = uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("theory-lesson-revision")).String()
	requirement := HybridLessonRequirement{ID: uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("theory-requirement")).String(), ActivityID: uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("theory-activity")).String(), Type: "theory_acknowledged", Required: true, Satisfied: true, SourceReference: HybridLessonSourceReference{ID: uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("theory-source")).String()}}
	item.FrozenRequirements = []HybridLessonRequirement{requirement}
	s.ActivityFacts = []HybridSnapshotActivityFact{{ItemID: item.ID, RequirementID: requirement.ID, Type: requirement.Type, SourceID: requirement.SourceReference.ID, FactID: uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("theory-fact")).String(), OccurredAt: s.CapturedAt}}
	rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
	c, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
	if err != nil || c.Outcome != HybridOutcomeNoChange || !hasHybridReason(c, "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_QUALITY") {
		t.Fatalf("observation-only changed future %+v err=%v", c, err)
	}
}

func TestHybridEvaluatorProjectQualityPositiveAndWrongIntentKindFailsClosed(t *testing.T) {
	s, inputs := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
	for i := range s.Evidence {
		e := &s.Evidence[i]
		e.SourceKind = "practice_v2"
		e.SurfaceClassification = "project"
		e.TaskInstanceID = e.TaskID
		e.TaskID = ""
		e.TaskRevisionID = uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("project-revision")).String()
		e.SubmissionID = e.EvidenceID
		e.ReceiptHash = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64)
	}
	rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
	c, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
	if err != nil || c.ApplicationMode != HybridApplicationAuto || len(c.Mutations) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("project provenance positive blocked %+v err=%v", c, err)
	}
	s.PendingIntent = &HybridLearningIntentProjection{IntentID: uuid.New().String(), StudentID: s.StudentID, LearningPathID: s.LearningPathID, ExpectedPathRevision: s.Path.Version, Kind: "CANCEL_ACTIVE_ACTIVITY", CreatedAt: s.CapturedAt, RequestedChange: HybridRequestedChange{Scope: HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: "changed.goal", DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}}, Mutations: []HybridFutureMutation{}}}
	rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
	if _, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("active-cancel intent authorized unrelated goal change")
	}
}

func TestHybridConsequenceTargetBoundMatchesOwnerFiveHundred(t *testing.T) {
	s, inputs := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
	c, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, count := range []int{100, 101, 500, 501} {
		c.SnapshotTargets = []HybridTargetRef{}
		for n := 0; n < count; n++ {
			c.SnapshotTargets = append(c.SnapshotTargets, HybridTargetRef{Type: TargetConcept, Key: fmt.Sprintf("target-%03d", n), Version: "v1"})
		}
		err := ValidateHybridConsequence(c)
		if (count <= 500) != (err == nil) {
			t.Fatalf("targets=%d validation=%v", count, err)
		}
	}
}

func TestHybridSyntheticReplacementNeedsActualFrozenTemplate(t *testing.T) {
	s, inputs := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
	scope := HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: s.Path.GoalCode, DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}}
	s.PendingIntent = &HybridLearningIntentProjection{IntentID: uuid.New().String(), StudentID: s.StudentID, LearningPathID: s.LearningPathID, ExpectedPathRevision: s.Path.Version, Kind: "SUBSTANTIAL_SCOPE_CHANGE", CreatedAt: s.CapturedAt, RequestedChange: HybridRequestedChange{Scope: scope, Mutations: []HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "REPLACE_PENDING_ITEM_WITH_EQUIVALENT_SAME_GOAL_ITEM", ItemID: s.Path.Items[1].ID, TemplateItemID: s.Path.Items[0].ID}}}}
	rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
	if _, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("bare legacy UUID supplied authored frozen material")
	}
	item := &s.Path.Items[0]
	item.LessonRevisionID = uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("frozen-template-revision")).String()
	item.FrozenRequirements = []HybridLessonRequirement{{ID: uuid.New().String(), ActivityID: uuid.New().String(), Type: "theory_acknowledged", Required: true, SourceReference: HybridLessonSourceReference{ID: uuid.New().String()}}}
	rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
	c, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
	if err != nil || c.ApplicationMode != HybridApplicationRequiresIntent || len(c.Mutations) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("exact frozen equivalent template rejected %+v err=%v", c, err)
	}
}

func TestHybridSyntheticRemoveActiveProjectNeedsKnownProjectBinding(t *testing.T) {
	s, inputs := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
	s.PendingIntent = &HybridLearningIntentProjection{IntentID: uuid.New().String(), StudentID: s.StudentID, LearningPathID: s.LearningPathID, ExpectedPathRevision: s.Path.Version, Kind: "REMOVE_ACTIVE_PROJECT", CreatedAt: s.CapturedAt, RequestedChange: HybridRequestedChange{Scope: HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: s.Path.GoalCode, DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}}, Mutations: []HybridFutureMutation{{Kind: "REMOVE_ACTIVE_PROJECT", ItemID: s.Path.Items[0].ID}}}}
	rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
	if _, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("READY lesson fabricated active project classification")
	}
	revision := uuid.New().String()
	s.Path.Items[0].ReferenceType = "practice"
	s.Path.Items[0].ReferenceID = revision
	s.PracticeBindings = []HybridPracticeBinding{{LearningActionID: uuid.New().String(), TaskInstanceID: uuid.New().String(), TaskRevisionID: revision, TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("c", 64), LearningPathID: s.LearningPathID, SurfaceClassification: "project", LifecycleStatus: "OPEN", LearningTargets: s.Path.Items[0].Targets, LearningPathVersionReservation: 1, LearningPathPositionReservation: 0}}
	rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
	c, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
	if err != nil || c.ApplicationMode != HybridApplicationRequiresIntent {
		t.Fatalf("known project proposal %+v err=%v", c, err)
	}
	s.PracticeBindings[0].SurfaceClassification = "practice"
	rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
	if _, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("practice binding fabricated project")
	}
}

func TestHybridSyntheticInsertReservesUniqueIdentityAndAggregateCapacity(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name        string
		itemCount   int
		sameNewID   bool
		insertCount int
		valid       bool
	}{{"duplicate new identity", 3, true, 2, false}, {"aggregate path ceiling", 499, false, 2, false}, {"exact path ceiling", 499, false, 1, true}} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			s, base := hybridEvaluatorFixture(t)
			s.Evidence = []HybridEvidenceReference{}
			s.Mastery[0] = HybridSnapshotMastery{Target: s.RequestedTargets[0], State: MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: StudentMasteryPolicyVersion}
			template := &s.Path.Items[0]
			template.LessonRevisionID = uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte("insert-frozen-template")).String()
			template.FrozenRequirements = []HybridLessonRequirement{{ID: uuid.New().String(), ActivityID: uuid.New().String(), Type: "theory_acknowledged", Required: true, SourceReference: HybridLessonSourceReference{ID: uuid.New().String()}}}
			for len(s.Path.Items) < tc.itemCount {
				item := s.Path.Items[1]
				item.ID = uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(fmt.Sprintf("insert-anchor-%d", len(s.Path.Items)))).String()
				item.Position = len(s.Path.Items)
				s.Path.Items = append(s.Path.Items, item)
			}
			mutations := []HybridFutureMutation{}
			for n := 0; n < tc.insertCount; n++ {
				identity := n
				if tc.sameNewID {
					identity = 0
				}
				position := n + 1
				mutations = append(mutations, HybridFutureMutation{Kind: "INSERT_FUTURE_REMEDIATION", ItemID: s.Path.Items[n+1].ID, TemplateItemID: s.Path.Items[0].ID, NewItemID: uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(fmt.Sprintf("insert-new-%d", identity))).String(), TargetPosition: &position})
			}
			s.PendingIntent = &HybridLearningIntentProjection{IntentID: uuid.New().String(), StudentID: s.StudentID, LearningPathID: s.LearningPathID, ExpectedPathRevision: s.Path.Version, Kind: "SUBSTANTIAL_SCOPE_CHANGE", CreatedAt: s.CapturedAt, RequestedChange: HybridRequestedChange{Scope: HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: s.Path.GoalCode, DirectionCode: s.Profile.DirectionCode, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}}, Mutations: mutations}}
			rehashHybridEvaluatorFixture(t, &s)
			graph := HybridPrerequisiteGraph{Available: true, GoalCode: s.Path.GoalCode, GoalVersion: "v1", GraphVersion: "v1", Targets: []HybridPrerequisiteTarget{{Ref: s.RequestedTargets[0], Prerequisites: []HybridTargetRef{}}}}
			inputs, err := NormalizeHybridConsequenceInputs(base.Policy, graph)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			c, err := EvaluateHybridSnapshot(s, inputs)
			if tc.valid {
				if err != nil || c.ApplicationMode != HybridApplicationRequiresIntent || !hasHybridReason(c, "EXISTING_PREREQUISITE_GAP") {
					t.Fatalf("valid exact ceiling c=%+v err=%v", c, err)
				}
			} else if err == nil {
				t.Fatalf("invalid insertion identities/capacity accepted %+v", c)
			}
		})
	}
}
